title: Docs: align audit log event names + Console labels with current UI
author: Wei Chen
release_notes: Docs-only change. No product/runtime behavior changes.
body:
## Summary
This PR updates a handful of product-doc annotations (audit log event names + a few Console labels/paths) so that what we claim in security reviews matches what customers see in the Redwood Console today.

This is intentionally small and non-functional: no API changes, no event emission changes. This is documentation + UI label alignment only.

## Why
Sales/SEs have flagged a mismatch during security questionnaires where the one-pager / FAQ language references audit log events and navigation labels that no longer match the Console. In a couple of cases we also used older event names from the pre-unification audit logger.

Specific issues observed:
- Docs referenced "org.audit.export" and "user.sso.login" which do not appear in the current UI event filter list.
- Console navigation changed from "Settings → Organization" to "Admin → Organization" and the docs lagged.
- RFP responses and screenshots call the page "Audit Logs", but one doc page still said "Audit Events".

## Changes
- Audit log docs: rename event examples to match the current event name catalog surfaced in Console.
  - Replace examples of deprecated event names (kept in older drafts) with current canonical names.
  - Add a short note clarifying that event names may evolve and customers should treat the schema as versioned.
- Console label/path updates:
  - Update breadcrumbs and callouts to "Admin → Audit Logs" (Hosted/Dedicated) and "Admin → Organization".
  - Replace "Audit Events" wording with "Audit Logs" to match the product.
- Clarify that export destinations are configured under "Admin → Audit Logs → Export" (where applicable) and that SIEM forwarding availability depends on deployment mode.

## Example edits (illustrative)
Before (docs):
- Event: `user.sso.login`
- Location: Settings → Organization → Audit Events

After (docs):
- Event: `auth.sso.login`
- Location: Admin → Audit Logs

## Files / areas touched
- `docs/security/audit-logging.md`
- `docs/security/enterprise-controls.md`
- `docs/console/navigation.md`
- `docs/snippets/audit-log-events.yml` (example list used in multiple pages)
- `console/help/security-review-links.md` (internal help panel content for SE-driven reviews)

## QA
- Built docs locally (`pnpm docs:build`) and verified links render.
- Verified event name examples match current Console filter list (Prod as of 2026-01-22) for Hosted.
- Verified Dedicated wording doesn’t over-commit (keeps "where available" language).

## Checklist
- [x] Docs build passes
- [x] No security claims added (only naming/label alignment)
- [x] Avoided "always/never" language

## Notes for enablement kit owners
This PR is meant to remove minor inconsistencies that show up when customers cross-check the FAQ/one-pagers against the Console UI during a live security review.

---

# Commit summary
1. docs(audit): update example event names + add schema-version note
2. docs(console): align Admin navigation labels (Audit Logs/Organization)
3. docs(snippets): refresh shared event name snippet list

# CI
Checks:
- build-and-test: PASS
- lint: PASS
- docs-build: PASS
- link-check: PASS

# Review conversation (highlights)
**Kevin Osei (Security SME):** The event name swap looks right. Can we avoid implying export is available for all deployments? Some Private installs wire this differently.

**Wei Chen (author):** Good call. Updated the export section to say "where enabled" and added a Hosted/Dedicated/Private callout.

**Ethan Park:** +1 on clarifying naming stability. Suggest explicitly stating we version the schema and may add events without notice, but we won’t rename without release notes.

**Wei Chen (author):** Added wording: "event set may expand; event renames/deprecations are communicated via release notes" (kept non-committal about timelines).

**Naomi Feldman:** Please keep the wording consistent with the security enablement kit (uses "Audit Logs").

**Wei Chen (author):** Done. Replaced remaining "Audit Events" references.

**Elliot Price:** Docs build + link check look good. Approved.

# Merge outcome
Merged via squash into `main` on 2026-01-25.
